:::{#sol-cross-entropy-numeric-expectation}

1.  The variable $Y$ equals $-\log_2 \tfrac{1}{4} = 2$ when $X \in \set{1, 3}$,
    and $-\log_2 \tfrac{1}{2} = 1$ when $X = 2$.
    So $\P(Y = 2) = p_1 + p_3 = \tfrac{3}{4}$ and $\P(Y = 1) = p_2 = \tfrac{1}{4}$.

2.  From this [mass function](random-variables.qmd#def-pmf),

    $$
    \ba
    \E{Y}
    &= 2 \cd \tfrac{3}{4} + 1 \cd \tfrac{1}{4} \\
    &= \tfrac{7}{4}.
    \ea
    $$

:::
